label: Private destination allowlist
description: Authorize policy- and vault-bound private recipients for two exact interaction contents.
source:
let recipient = $subjectArg(0)
and mask = $subjectArg(1)
and commitment = $keccak(0x71f90f3a8926b9c9550cd8fc426a13aa002de13f6e7c88186a4cbc598a7991fd, $subjectPolicy, $subjectVault, recipient, mask, 2)
and allowed = $read(__REGISTRY__, 0x04ffd4ca, {$subjectPolicy, 0x1d4dd30ca9180f6bc326636fbe4d470dbb83ee1803b02f6ffc5f030f2df0b34e, $subjectVault, commitment})
and exactInteractionA = $subjectId == __INTERACTION_A__ && $read(__REGISTRY__, 0x72ef7752, {__INTERACTION_A__}) == __CONTENT_A__
and exactInteractionB = $subjectId == __INTERACTION_B__ && $read(__REGISTRY__, 0x72ef7752, {__INTERACTION_B__}) == __CONTENT_B__
in {
  $require(exactInteractionA || exactInteractionB),
  $require(recipient <= 0x000000000000000000000000ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff),
  $require(recipient != 0),
  $require(allowed == 1),
}

label: Interaction allowlist
description: Restrict to allowed interaction ids using $arg0.
source:
let interactionA = __INTERACTION_A__
and interactionB = __INTERACTION_B__
in
$require($arg0 == interactionA || $arg0 == interactionB)

label: Pause switch
description: Reads one policy state slot and rejects every interaction while it is set.

label: Remaining budget
description: Values the interaction through VALUE_USD18_V1 and spends down one remaining-budget state slot.

label: Daily meter budget
description: Values the interaction through VALUE_USD18_V1 and applies the built-in policy meter for a 24h budget.

label: Monthly reset budget
description: Values the interaction through VALUE_USD18_V1 and applies start_date and monthly_budget state slots.
source:
let amountUsd18 = $staticLinked(0x8056936f000da0a913d0b15d1eff060dccd4cfaca1f5fa8c46e02449c44ed27b)
and startDate = $read(__REGISTRY__, 0x04ffd4ca, {$subjectPolicy, 0x113143cfdb0c95b643ca7967e017fd48f29298face27e8417f6bff4ebf172fa4, 0x8d006467b3c133109531cfd458b779cc5a3370a82e716c97797f249f312e2c1d, 0xe672116e2c9a5ef3df8968e5633765eb0589e64f03c381569c33a15c58c3faf4})
and remainingBudget = $read(__REGISTRY__, 0x04ffd4ca, {$subjectPolicy, 0x113143cfdb0c95b643ca7967e017fd48f29298face27e8417f6bff4ebf172fa4, 0x8d006467b3c133109531cfd458b779cc5a3370a82e716c97797f249f312e2c1d, 0xea959485fd07c9d089f5031a39022f582221663095d34f7f83ae4fc7b897249a})
and elapsed = $arg6 - startDate
and reset = elapsed >= 2592000
and currentBudget = IF(reset, 100000000000000000000000, remainingBudget)
and nextStartDate = $arg6 - (elapsed % 2592000)
in {
  $require(startDate != 0),
  $require(amountUsd18 <= currentBudget),
  IF(!reset, $noOp, $require($write(__REGISTRY__, 0x21f1e4cb, {$subjectPolicy, 0x113143cfdb0c95b643ca7967e017fd48f29298face27e8417f6bff4ebf172fa4, 0x8d006467b3c133109531cfd458b779cc5a3370a82e716c97797f249f312e2c1d, 0xe672116e2c9a5ef3df8968e5633765eb0589e64f03c381569c33a15c58c3faf4, nextStartDate}))),
  $require($write(__REGISTRY__, 0x21f1e4cb, {$subjectPolicy, 0x113143cfdb0c95b643ca7967e017fd48f29298face27e8417f6bff4ebf172fa4, 0x8d006467b3c133109531cfd458b779cc5a3370a82e716c97797f249f312e2c1d, 0xea959485fd07c9d089f5031a39022f582221663095d34f7f83ae4fc7b897249a, currentBudget - amountUsd18})),
}

label: Capability grants: 3 minutes / registry manager: 1 hour
description: Require three minutes for ordinary capability actions and one hour for registry manager group grants.
